in_marathi.name: Jaladhi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Water carrier, oceanic
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaladhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaladhi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'jalada' which means 'carrying water' or 'oceanic'. This name is believed to have been given to those who live near water sources or are involved in water-related professions. In Hindu mythology, Jaladhi is also an epithet of Lord Vishnu, signifying his role as the preserver of water.
